clarification: Current own clinical-service catalog explicitly advertising oncology at one exact physical branch, together with current qualified veterinary role/contact/intake, can support narrow advertised Local oncology care. Detailed protocols or a separately named modality are not an added barrier. Network footer, educational article or biographical interest alone do not allocate branch care. Do not rewrite advertised Oncology as proven specific treatment delivery, chemotherapy, surgery, radiotherapy, protocol, consultation format or specialist credential.
